editDialog.title: Edit {{name}}
editDialog.urlHelp: Changing it asks for the host keys of a new SSH host again.
editDialog.defaultRefHelp: Leave it empty to deploy the remote's default branch.
editDialog.hostKeysIntro: Fetch the host's keys again to trust another key. Only the keys you tick replace the trusted ones.
editDialog.waiting: Asking a worker to fetch the keys…
editDialog.none: The host offered no SSH key. Check the URL, then fetch again.

replaceDialog.title: Replace the deploy key of {{environment}}?
replaceDialog.body: The old key stops working at once. Deploys from {{environment}} fail until you add the new key at your git host.

missingDialog.title: Make the missing keys of {{name}}?
missingDialog.body: Lakana makes a deploy key in each environment where you manage secrets and the repository has none. The private keys stay on the server.

deleteDialog.title: Delete repository {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: Jobs already deployed keep running until undeployed; nothing at your git host changes.
